lessons.story:
SCHOOL SWAP DAY: Bring clean books or complete board games to the hall between eight and nine on Friday. Volunteers check every item. For each accepted item, you receive one swap ticket. Broken games, loose game pieces, and written-in workbooks cannot be accepted.

The swap table opens at ten. Each ticket may be exchanged for one item. Tickets have no cash value and cannot be used at the food stand. You may give an unused ticket to another student, but you may not sell it.

At eleven thirty, the remaining items will be offered to the school library. If you want an unclaimed item returned to you instead, tell the volunteers when you first bring it. Write your name clearly on the return list.

You do not have to bring an item to visit the event. Visitors without tickets may browse and join the free board-game demonstration. The demonstration starts at ten thirty, and the volunteer will explain the rules before anyone begins playing.
lessons.title: The Swap Table Rules
